title: Proposal frontmatter (v1)
description: Structural contract for doc/improvements/proposals/*.md and their archived copies under doc/improvements/archive/** (corpus_uniformity S3, option 2 FULL, user-selected 2026-08-31). The bold-line Date/Status/Area header STAYS for human readers; this block is the machine-checkable status. Lifecycle agreement (proposals/ = proposed, archive/ = executed with a completed.md number, README live-list hygiene) is enforced by static_checks' Proposal lifecycle check — this schema covers structure only, same division as the note schemas.

title.description: From the # heading; imperative, names the mechanism.

status.description: 'proposed' while in proposals/; 'executed' once archived (directory agreement enforced by static_checks).

filed.description: Date the proposal was filed into proposals/.

executed.description: Null while proposed; the execution date once archived.

completed_md.description: The completed.md entry number as a string ('189'; suffix form '105b' for resolved duplicate numbers; '145+146' when one proposal spans several entries). Null while proposed.

area.description: Primary code/doc surface (first segment of the bold-line Area header; archive topic dir as fallback).

isoDate.description: ISO calendar date (YYYY-MM-DD). NOTE: unquoted YAML dates are auto-parsed into date objects by PyYAML; the validator normalizes these to ISO strings before checking.
